meetings.ours_headline: Cemetery Commission heard complaints about unkempt cemeteries and approved a headstone, flowers up to a cap; hedge quote and plan tabled.

votes.motion: Accept the April 26th meeting minutes.
votes.quote: the vice-chair, dorren made a motion to accept the april 26th meeting minutes, commissioner michael clark, seconded the motioned: motion passed 3-0.

votes.motion: Allow a second headstone on the family grave-site in South Cemetery.
votes.quote: vice-chair, david dorren made a motion to allow the second headstone on the family grave-site. commissioner clark, seconded the motion. motion was passed 3-0.

votes.motion: Have Lakeview provide the planting of flowers at the North and South Cemetery entrances, up to $500.00.
votes.quote: vice-chair, dorren made a motion to have lakeview provide the planting of flowers, up to $500.00; commissioner michael clark, seconded the motion. motion passed 3-0.

meetings.ours_headline: Cemetery Commission voted to allow one large headstone over four or six South Cemetery plots; mowing dispute stayed unresolved.

votes.quote: the commission approved 3-0 the family to have one headstone for the four plots.

votes.motion: Adjourn the meeting at 10:56AM.
votes.quote: vice-chair david dorren made the motion to adjourn at 10:56am: clerk mile clark seconded the motion. motion passed 3-0.
